sections.title: 4 · 下周展望
sections.body:
The tape is one risk-on posture priced through options while capital rotates out of long-duration equity underneath it. Watch whether vol extends its fall or snaps back — a reversal would say today was a one-session squeeze rather than a stance. Credit is the tell: as long as spreads hold near the cycle tight, the rotation is positioning, not stress. The Semi-Cap and Cybersecurity fades run weeks ahead of their earnings, so there is no print to blame — it is money leaving the names whose value sits furthest out. The 9/16 FOMC is the next hard date the strip still reads as a coin-toss toward tightening; vol falling into it is the pair worth watching. Devices and the megacap model proxies are where the crowded side now sits. If the front-end series ever ingests, the curve read reopens; until then the duration story lives entirely in the equity sector rows.
